entries.content_plain: PSALM 82 Psa 82:1-8 . Before the great Judge, the judges of the earth are rebuked, exhorted, and threatened. 1. congregation-- (Compare Ex 12:3 ; 16:1 ). of the mighty-- that is, of God, of His appointment. the gods-- or, "judges" ( Ex 21:6 ; 22:9 ), God's representatives.
